title: Identify European Firaga linked transfer candidates
changes: Identify a conditional original index-2 path to a type-3 row and descriptor that reference an existing wrapper and compressed stream.
validation: Wine disassembly e355-firaga-residual-readers-disassembly-wine-fvczyws1 passes with server drained; existing E342 data and E286/E287 reader evidence identify the candidate source links.
Exact EUR inspection finds both candidate spans unowned in E272 and 17 of their 20 bytes in the address-only E302 residual.
limitations: The sample does not establish executing PCs or prove the conditional ancestry occurred. Source authentication, runtime publication, other callers and scenes remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made. Focused Sol xhigh requested, effective settings unconfirmed.
